title: perfect rightAdjoint tensor hom comparison
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes with the derived categories of sheaves of modules [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullback $F=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image $R=Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Suppose $R$ preserves quasi-coherent cohomology, the tensor unit on $Y$ has quasi-coherent cohomology, and $F(J)\otimes E$ has quasi-coherent cohomology for every quasi-coherent $J,E$. Choose a strong monoidal structure on $F$, an adjunction $a:F\dashv R$, and a right adjoint $c$ to the restriction of $R$ to the full quasi-coherent subcategories, with adjunction $b:R\dashv c$. Let $K,D$ be quasi-coherent objects on $Y$ with evaluation $D\otimes K\to1$ and coevaluation $1\to K\otimes D$ satisfying both triangle identities. Give their pullbacks the mapped exact pairing. Write $O$ for the unit on $Y$. For every quasi-coherent $E$ on $X$, suppose isomorphisms $p_K:R(F(K)\otimes c(O))\to K\otimes R(c(O))$ and $p_D:R(F(D)\otimes E)\to D\otimes R(E)$ are given, whose inverses are the $a$-adjuncts of the inverse tensorators followed by tensoring with the counit of $a$. For every $q:E\to F(K)\otimes c(O)$, the successive Hom bijections given by pulled tensor duality, $b^{-1}$, precomposition with $p_D^{-1}$, tensor duality on $Y$, the right unitor, and $b$ send $q$ to $q$ followed by the $b$-adjunct of $p_K$, then $K$ tensor the counit of $b$ at $O$, then the right unitor of $K$. All Hom sets are those of the full quasi-coherent subcategories, with the displayed closure hypotheses furnishing their objects.

proof.text: For two adjunctions and a transformation between their left adjoints, prove that postcomposing the first Hom transpose with the conjugate transformation equals the second Hom transpose of precomposition with the original transformation. Expand homEquiv through the unit, use naturality of the conjugate transformation and Mathlib unit_conjugateEquiv. This is the proved private helper conjugate_homEquiv.

Apply this identity to the composite tensor duality and pullback adjunctions, and the tensorator at D. Identify its conjugate at c(O) with pfK.inv using [lem-sc-monoidal-projection-conjugate] and hpK. Expand the composite Hom equivalences, use hpD and naturality of a.homEquiv, and cancel the tensorator against its inverse. Naturality of pulled tensor duality transforms the counit followed by q; the adjunction triangle identity leaves R(q). Cancel pfK.inv to obtain tensorLeftHomEquiv(pfD.inv followed by R of the inverse duality image of q) = R(q) followed by pfK.hom. This is the proved private helper projection_duality.

Express the inverse right-adjoint transpose of the pulled-back tensor-duality image as R of that image followed by the right-adjoint counit at O. Apply injectivity of the inverse right-adjoint Hom equivalence to the desired identity. Naturality transposes postcomposition with the canonical mate into R(q) followed by its defining morphism. Reduce equality of full-subcategory morphisms to equality of their ambient morphisms. Tensor-duality naturality moves the counit outside the Hom equivalence, then projection_duality identifies the remaining factor. Associativity finishes after appending the right unitor.

theorem perfect_rightAdjoint_tensor_hom_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ c)
    (K D : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) [ExactPairing K.obj D.obj]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (pfK : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
        (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
      K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)
    (hpK : pfK.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
        (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj))
    (pfD : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
        (((derivedPullback f).obj D.obj) ⊗ E.obj) ≅
      D.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)
    (hpD : pfD.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) D.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)).inv ≫
        (derivedPullback f).obj D.obj ◁ a.counit.app E.obj))
    (q : E ⟶ ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
      hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩) :
    let p := ExactPairing.map (derivedPullback f) K.obj D.obj
    (adj.homEquiv E K)
      (ObjectProperty.homMk
        (tensorLeftHomEquiv ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj) K.obj D.obj
          (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))
          (pfD.inv ≫ ((adj.homEquiv
            ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj D.obj) ⊗ E.obj, hTensor D E⟩ ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).symm
            (ObjectProperty.homMk
              ((@tensorLeftHomEquiv _ _ _ E.obj ((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj)
                ((derivedPullback f).obj D.obj) (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj p).symm
                q.hom))).hom) ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom)) =
      q ≫ (adj.homEquiv
        ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
          hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩ K)
        (ObjectProperty.homMk (pfK.hom ≫
          K.obj ◁ (adj.counit.app ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom))
